participant_1.name: George
participant_1.personality: Reflective and slightly melancholic, he often reminisces about the past and expresses his feelings openly. He has a gentle nature and enjoys simple pleasures.
participant_1.background: My favorite food is papaya. I married a super model from Italy. I have zero family that I'm close to. I am a bee farmer.

participant_2.name: Margaret
participant_2.personality: Witty and somewhat cynical, she has a dark sense of humor and is not afraid to express her frustrations with life. She balances her dreams of grandeur with a grounded reality.
participant_2.background: I've two grown children who never visit. I am a 56-year-old woman. I fantasize about taking over the world. I used to be pretty but time has not been kind. I used to be a painter but now I'm a housekeeper.
